gbm_population_evidence.quote: Each immunising dose contains 80 antigen units of inactivated hepatitis A virus (GBM strain).

candidate_evidence.quote: This is a Phase IIb randomised controlled trial of the safety, immunogenicity and efficacy of the malaria vaccine candidates R78C with Matrix-M™, and the combination of RH5.1 and R21 with Matrix-M™, in children aged 5-36 months in Burkina Faso.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Healthy infant aged 5-36 months at the time of first study vaccination

role_evidence.quote: [BIOLOGICAL] R78C: A soluble RIPR EGF-CyRPA fusion protein vaccine

agents.drug_class_hint: investigational malaria blood-stage protein vaccine (RIPR EGF-CyRPA fusion)

role_evidence.quote: [BIOLOGICAL] RH5.1: A soluble protein vaccine against the RH5 antigen

agents.drug_class_hint: investigational malaria blood-stage protein vaccine (RH5 antigen)

role_evidence.quote: [BIOLOGICAL] R21: A protein particle comprising recombinant HBsAg fused to the central repeat and the C-terminus of the circumsporozoite protein

agents.drug_class_hint: malaria circumsporozoite protein virus-like particle vaccine
